name: Postiz
tagline: AI-native open-source social media post scheduler across 28+ platforms
description:
An open-source, self-hosted social media management tool. Schedule and cross-post updates to Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Instagram, Threads, and YouTube with built-in AI copywriting agents.

Vibecoded with Cursor and Astra / Claude agents to automate social media scheduling workflows and handle OAuth compliance across dozens of platforms.

replaces.note: Uncapped multi-channel social scheduling with automated AI agent copy refinement.
